SYNTHETIC REPORT R2 (written for tests; not a real advisory)

The "GreyMoth" implant beacons every 60 seconds to 198.51.100.23 over TCP/443. A second
stage is fetched from http://static-assets.example.org/a/b.ps1 and its SHA1 is
da39a3ee5e6b4b0d3255bfef95601890afd80709. The same actor exploited CVE-2099-2222 and CVE-2099-3333.
File names such as payload.exe or loader.dll are not network indicators.
